title: uragoga tylophora
intro: Uragoga tylophora, commonly known as the "Mad Hopper" or "Katki", is a perennial climber native to the tropical forests of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory disorders, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Uragoga tylophora include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its efficacy in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
